WITH region_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), region_shares AS (
    SELECT region, client_count,
           1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM region_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT client_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM region_shares
)
SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_clients,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;
